annotations.title: Open federal contract notices from Hawaiʻi offices

description: SAM.gov contract notices posted by offices in Hawaiʻi whose response deadline has not passed, from SAM.gov's public Opportunities API: title, notice type, agency path, NAICS code, set-aside, response deadline, place of performance as published, and the notice's public SAM.gov link (contacts, descriptions and attachments are only there). Listed in Hawaiʻi first (The Mine's own classification of the place of performance), then performed elsewhere. Award notices and justifications are not listed. Each notice and the list carry retrieved_at. Deadlines and details change. Confirm on SAM.gov before you rely on them. Figures are official statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Coverage labels matter: read the coverage line (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Repeat each figure's notice when you use it. Facts, not investment or other advice.
